page.title: System Settings
page.description: How this device keeps time, when it restarts, and which SIMs it remembers.

page.title: Device Access
page.description: The password and ports used to reach this modem.

page.title: Hardware
page.description: How Ethernet traffic and a connected host reach the modem's hardware.

diagnostics.card_description: A snapshot of this modem to share when troubleshooting.
diagnostics.body: Generates a plain-text snapshot of the modem's current state (radio status, network configuration, and recent logs) and downloads it to your device. No data leaves the modem until you choose to share the file.
diagnostics.toast_failed: Couldn't capture diagnostics. Please try again.

ipa_offload.card_description: Route packet processing through the modem's IPA hardware path.
ipa_offload.cpu_warning: If you see random Ethernet drops, turn it off to route traffic through the CPU.
ipa_offload.unavailable_hint: This modem's firmware has no hardware offload path to change.
ipa_offload.toast_enabled: Hardware offload enabled. Reboot to apply.
ipa_offload.toast_disabled: Hardware offload disabled. Reboot to apply.
ipa_offload.error_description: The setting didn't load. Try again in a moment.
ipa_offload.path_hint: IPA is the modem's built-in packet engine. With offload on, Ethernet traffic is handled in hardware and skips the CPU; with it off, the CPU handles every packet.
ipa_offload.path_aria_hardware: Ethernet traffic goes through the hardware path to the cellular network.
ipa_offload.path_aria_cpu: Ethernet traffic goes through the CPU to the cellular network.

host_at.card_description: AT access for a computer connected over USB or PCIe.
host_at.consequence_usb: A connected computer can't send AT commands while this is off.
host_at.consequence_pcie: The host this modem is installed in can't send AT commands while this is off.
host_at.unavailable: This firmware has no host AT ports.
host_at.error_description: The setting didn't load. Try again in a moment.
host_at.path_hint: QManager always reaches the modem over its own internal link. Host access only decides whether a computer on USB or PCIe can send AT commands too.
host_at.path_aria_open: A connected computer and QManager can both send AT commands to the modem.
host_at.path_aria_closed: Only QManager can send AT commands to the modem; the computer's port is closed.

config_backup.page_description: Save an encrypted copy of your settings, or restore one onto this modem.
config_backup.reboot_failed_toast: Couldn't start the reboot. Try again.

create.card_description: Choose what to include, then encrypt the file with a passphrase.
create.profile_uncheck_hint: Clear network mode, TTL and IMEI to include profiles
create.warning: Without it the backup can't be opened. There is no way to recover it.

restore.card_description: Replace the settings a backup contains with the values saved in it.
restore.idle_description: Choose a .qmbackup file made by QManager.
restore.passphrase_consequence: The passphrase set when this backup was created.
restore.password_incorrect: Incorrect passphrase. Check it and try again.
restore.model_warning: Made on {{from}}, restoring onto {{to}}. Sections this modem can't use are skipped.
restore.reboot_dialog_description: An IMEI change or SIM profile takes effect after a reboot. This page is unavailable for about a minute.

pipeline.title: Restoring backup
pipeline.reboot_notice: Some changes take effect after a reboot. You choose when.
pipeline.failed_hint: Failed sections keep their current values. Check them on their own pages.

page.title: Software Update
page.description: QManager checks GitHub for a newer release and installs it on the modem itself. Installing replaces the app and restarts the device, so the session you are reading this in will drop and come back.
page.description_managed: QManager was installed as a software package, so its updates come from the package manager.

latest.caption_installing: Step {{step}} of 4 — do not power off

auto.caption_on: Daily check at a randomised time
auto.caption_managed: Not available for a package install

loading.title: Checking for Updates
loading.description: Reading the release list from GitHub.

unreachable.title: Update Service Unavailable
unreachable.description: QManager can't reach the update endpoint on this modem, so it can't say what is installed or what is available.

check_failed.title: The Update Check Failed
check_failed.description: The build on this modem is untouched. QManager just couldn't read the release list this time.

download_failed.title: The Download Didn't Finish
download_failed.description: Nothing has been replaced. The build already on this modem is untouched, so it is safe to try the download again.

install_failed.title: The Install Didn't Finish
install_failed.description: The modem may be running a mixed set of files. Installing again puts it back on a known build.

up_to_date.title: You're on the Latest Build
up_to_date.description: Nothing to install. The four steps below are what an update does when one arrives.

available.title: Update Available
available.description: Downloading and installing takes a few minutes and ends in a restart. This is exactly what happens.

downloading.title: Downloading the Update
downloading.description: The package is being fetched from GitHub. Nothing has been replaced yet and the modem keeps working.

verifying.title: Verifying the Download
verifying.description: QManager is checking the package against its SHA-256 before anything is replaced.

staged.title: Ready to Install
staged.description: The package is downloaded and verified. Installing replaces QManager and restarts the modem.

installing.title: Installing the Update
installing.description: The app and its services are being replaced. Do not power off the modem.

rebooting.title: Restarting the Modem
rebooting.description: The install finished. The modem is restarting and this session drops until it comes back.

download.label: Download
download.detail: Fetches the release package from GitHub

verify.label: Verify
verify.detail: Checks the package against its SHA-256

install.label: Install
install.detail: Replaces the app and its services

reboot.label: Reboot
reboot.detail: The modem restarts. Your session will drop.

notice.rest: Installing restarts the modem, which drops this session and every connection through it for about a minute.
notice.staged: Installing replaces QManager and restarts the modem. This session drops and comes back on its own.
notice.running: Do not power off the modem.
notice.failed_check: QManager couldn't read the release list. The build on this modem is untouched, so this is a read failure and not a loss.
notice.failed_download: The download didn't finish, so nothing has been installed. The build already on the modem is untouched.
notice.versions: Every option here restarts the modem, and an older build can undo settings a newer one introduced.
notice.failed_install: The install did not finish, so the modem may be running a mixed set of files. Installing again puts it back on a known build.
notice.stalled: The installer has gone quiet for two minutes. If it does not recover, restart the modem to finish or undo the install.

notes.title: What Changed
notes.empty_description: GitHub returned no changelog for this release, so there's nothing to show here.

preferences.title: Update Preferences
preferences.description: How this modem decides when to update itself.

auto.label: Automatic updates
auto.description: Checks once a day at a randomised time and installs what it finds. The modem reboots to finish.

prerelease.label: Include pre-releases
prerelease.description: Offers builds marked pre-release on GitHub. They arrive earlier and have had less testing.

versions.title: Version Management
versions.description: Install, reinstall or roll back to any published build.

dialog.description_install: This installs {{version}} in place of {{current}}. The modem restarts when it finishes.
dialog.description_reinstall: This reinstalls {{version}} over the copy already on the modem, to repair it. The modem restarts when it finishes.
dialog.warning: Do not power off the modem while it is installing.

versions.empty_description: GitHub returned no releases carrying an installable package, so there is nothing to install or roll back to here.

banner.title: The last update did not finish
banner.description: A pending marker for {{pending}} survived a restart while {{version}} is running, so the installed files may be mixed. Reinstalling {{pending}} puts this modem back on a known build.
banner.description_unknown: An install did not finish while {{version}} is running, so the installed files may be mixed. Reinstalling puts this modem back on a known build.

unreachable.title: Can't reach the update service
unreachable.description: QManager couldn't reach the update endpoint on this modem. The build that is installed is untouched, so this is a read failure and not a loss.

managed.title: Updates through the package manager
managed.description: Upgrade QManager from the Software page in LuCI, like any other package.

package.label: Package
package.description: Its name in the package list.

stall_dialog.title: Restart the modem now?
stall_dialog.description: The install looks stuck. Restarting interrupts it and drops this session; the modem comes back on its own.

page.title: AT Terminal
page.description: Send AT commands straight to the modem and read its replies exactly as they come back. Commands that would take the radio off the air are held for confirmation first, and a few are refused outright.

card.title: Console
card.description: Replies are shown raw, in the modem's own words. The last 100 commands stay in this browser until you clear them.

empty.title: Nothing sent yet
empty.description: Type an AT command in the prompt below, or open Commands to pick a ready-made one.

transcript.label: Command transcript
transcript.copy: Copy this command and its reply

hint.label: Press Tab to complete this command from your history, or Shift+Tab to leave the field.

gate.title: This command can cut your connection

rules.not_at: Only AT commands can be sent here. Start the line with AT, for example AT+CSQ.
rules.qscanfreq: Frequency scans are refused here. They hold the radio off the air for minutes with nothing to show while they run — use the Cell Scanner page, which reports progress and can be stopped.
rules.qscan: Network scans are refused here. They hold the radio off the air for minutes with nothing to show while they run — use the Cell Scanner page, which reports progress and can be stopped.
rules.resetfactory: A factory reset is refused here. It clears every setting on the modem at once, including the ones QManager needs to reach it, and nothing on this page can undo it.
rules.reboot: This reboots the modem. Every connection through it drops, this page included, and anything still in flight is lost — it takes about a minute to come back, with its clock at January 1970 until the network sets it again.
rules.radio_off: This turns the modem's radio off. If you reached this page over the modem's own connection, Tailscale included, you lose this page until the radio is switched back on from the device itself.

responses.failed: The command failed and the modem gave no reason.
responses.unexpected: This command couldn't be sent. Check System Logs for what the backend reported.
responses.unreachable: Couldn't reach QManager's backend on the modem. Check that the device is still reachable, then send it again.

presets.mode_nr_lte: Set network mode to 5G NR and LTE
presets.mode_nr: Set network mode to 5G NR only
presets.mode_lte: Set network mode to LTE only
presets.nr5g_disable_status: Show which of SA and NSA are on

errors.required: Both a name and a command are required.
errors.must_start_at: The command has to start with AT.
errors.duplicate_command: That command is already in the list.
errors.duplicate_label: Another command already uses that name.

manage_dialog.title: Manage custom commands
manage_dialog.description: Commands you add here are saved in this browser and appear under Custom in the list.
manage_dialog.empty: You haven't added any custom commands yet.

page.title: Languages
page.description: Choose the language QManager's interface is shown in, and install community translation packs published for this device.

actions.refresh_aria: Refresh the installed languages and the community catalog

display.title: Display Language
display.description: Pick the language QManager's interface is written in. The change takes effect straight away, and only on this device.

remove.title: Remove {{language}}?
remove.description: This deletes the downloaded {{language}} pack from this device. You can install it again at any time.
remove.description_active: {{language}} is the language you are reading right now. Removing it switches QManager back to English.

community.title: Community Packs
community.description: Translation packs published for QManager by the community. Installing one adds it to the list above.

failure.manual: Nothing on the device was changed. You can install this pack by hand over SSH:

unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the pack catalog
unreachable.description: The device couldn't load the community pack list from GitHub. Your installed languages are untouched — this is a read that failed, and nothing on the modem has changed.

none.title: No community packs yet
none.description: Nobody has published a downloadable translation pack for QManager yet. The languages above are built into the firmware and are always available.

toast.switch_failed_detail: It may need to be installed again.

errors.generic: The language pack couldn't be installed.

game_over.title: GAME OVER
game_over.controls_hint: Enter to retry  •  Esc to exit

count.consequence: QManager remembers the SIMs it has seen, so it only alerts you when a genuinely new SIM is inserted. Clearing forgets every SIM except the one currently inserted.
count.label: SIMs remembered

states.empty_description: QManager records each SIM the first time it is inserted. Insert a SIM to start the list.
states.error_description: The device didn't answer. Nothing has been forgotten; this is a read failure and the count is still on the modem.

known_sims.clear_dialog_description: This forgets every SIM QManager has seen, except the one currently inserted — so your active SIM won't be flagged as new. Previously-used SIMs will alert again the next time they are inserted.

page.title: System Health Check
page.description: Check every QManager subsystem on this device, from the AT broker to services and the firewall, then download a redacted bundle to share with support.

clear_dialog.title: Clear diagnostic results?
clear_dialog.description: This deletes the last run, every per-test output file, and the downloadable bundle from the device. The page returns to its empty state.

attention.title: Needs Attention
attention.description: Every check that failed or raised a warning on the last run. Start here.

all_checks.title: All Checks
all_checks.description: Every probe the diagnostic ran, grouped by the subsystem it belongs to.

empty.title: No diagnostic has been run
empty.description: QManager probes every subsystem on this device and packages the results into a redacted bundle you can send to support.

running.title: Nothing has failed yet
running.description: The diagnostic is still working through its checks. Anything that fails or raises a warning appears here.

incomplete.title: This diagnostic didn't finish
incomplete.description: The runner stopped before every check reported, so the checks it never reached have no result at all. Nothing here says this device is healthy — run the diagnostic again.

all_clear.description: Nothing failed and nothing raised a warning. Every subsystem answered the way it should.

all_clear_skipped.description_one: Nothing failed and nothing raised a warning. {{count}} check was skipped, so this run says nothing about it.
all_clear_skipped.description_other: Nothing failed and nothing raised a warning. {{count}} checks were skipped, so this run says nothing about them.

error.title: Couldn't read the diagnostic
error.description: QManager asked the device for the last health-check run and didn't get an answer.

notice.run_error: The runner reported a problem while this diagnostic ran.

output.truncated: Showing the last 4 KB of captured output.

binaries.label: Binaries & Versions
binaries.description: Required tools and the AT broker binary

permissions.label: Filesystem & Permissions
permissions.description: Device nodes, the broker socket, writable paths and free space

at_transport.label: AT Transport
at_transport.description: Round trips through qcmd and the qmanager_atd broker

sms.label: SIM & SMS
sms.description: SIM readiness, SMS storage and the shared modem lock

services.label: Services
services.description: procd instances for the QManager daemons and the web server

network.label: Network
network.description: Mobile data address, reachability, DNS, web server and firewall

configuration.label: Configuration
configuration.description: UCI and JSON configs, cache freshness and the installed version

adaptive_polling.page_description: Query the modem less often while no one has QManager open.
adaptive_polling.card_description: Status refreshes at full rate while a page is open, then slows down.

enabled.label: Slow down when idle
enabled.on: Polling slows after the grace period below.
enabled.off: Status refreshes at full rate all the time.
enabled.hint: Alerts and the connection watchdog keep working at every rate. Only status refreshes slow down.

active_grace.label: Grace period
active_grace.consequence: Full rate continues this long after the last page closes ({{min}} to {{max}} s).

idle_interval.label: Idle interval
idle_interval.consequence: Time between refreshes while idle ({{min}} to {{max}} s).

idle_threshold.label: Deep idle after
idle_threshold.consequence: Idle time before refreshes slow further ({{min}} to {{max}} s).

deep_idle_interval.label: Deep idle interval
deep_idle_interval.consequence: Time between refreshes in deep idle ({{min}} to {{max}} s).

adaptive_polling.error_description: The settings didn't load. Try again in a moment.

page.title: System Logs
page.description: QManager keeps its log in memory on the modem, so it starts empty after every reboot and never wears the flash. Filter it here to see what each component has been doing.

card.title: Transcript
card.description: Showing {{shown}} lines. The live log holds {{held}}.

notice.stale: QManager lost contact while refreshing. These are the last lines it read from the device.

empty.title: The log is empty
empty.description: QManager keeps its log in memory and clears it on every reboot, so nothing has been written since this device last started.

empty_filtered.title: Nothing matches these filters
empty_filtered.description: The log has lines in it, but none of them match the level, component or search you picked.

error.title: Can't read the log
error.description: QManager couldn't reach the log reader on this device. The log itself is untouched, so this is a read failure and not a loss.

clear_dialog.title: Clear the system log?
clear_dialog.description: This empties the live log and deletes both archived files. Anything already written is gone for good, and new lines start arriving immediately.

clock.caption_unread: Could not read the time zone

reboot.caption_no_day: Enabled, but no day is selected

sims.caption_known: Only a new SIM raises an alert

card.title: Device & Units
card.description: How this modem keeps time, the units readings use, and the SIMs it remembers.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.consequence: The modem has no battery clock. This is what every log line, event and schedule is measured against.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.consequence: Applies to every temperature reading in QManager.

distance.label: Distance
distance.consequence: Applies to tower distance on the cell scanner and antenna pages.

states.error_body: QManager couldn't read this device's preferences. Nothing has been changed — the zone and units already saved are still in force on the modem.
states.error_body_detail: QManager couldn't read this device's preferences. Nothing has been changed — the zone and units already saved are still in force on the modem. The device said: {{detail}}
states.stale: The modem didn't answer the last request. What's shown is the last state it confirmed.

card.title: Scheduled Reboot
card.description: Restart the modem automatically on a weekly schedule.

enabled.label: Automatic reboot
enabled.consequence: The modem restarts on this schedule. Your session drops for about ninety seconds and comes back on its own.

time.label: Time
time.consequence: Local device time, not your browser's.

days.label: Repeat on
days.consequence: With no day selected the schedule never fires.

clock.label: Modem time
clock.consequence: The date and time the schedule runs on, in the time zone set under Device & Units.
clock.unsynced_consequence: The modem hasn't set its clock from the network yet, so a scheduled reboot can't fire until it does.

error.title: Can't read the schedules
error.description: QManager couldn't load this device's schedules. Anything already saved is still in force on the modem. This is a read failure, not a disarm.

states.stale: QManager lost contact while refreshing. These are the last values it read from the device.

toast.unsaved: Reboot schedule change wasn’t saved — you left the page before it could save.

card.title: Passwords
card.description: Change the password you sign in to QManager with, or the root password for SSH. Each asks for its current password first.

web.label: Current web password
web.consequence: The password you sign in to QManager with.
web.dialog_description: You will be signed out after changing it.

ssh.label: Current SSH password
ssh.consequence: The root password for SSH sessions into this modem.
ssh.dialog_description: Takes effect immediately; existing SSH sessions stay open.

errors.too_short: Password must be at least 5 characters.
errors.weak: Password must be at least 5 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, and a number.
errors.verify_failed: Couldn't check the password. Try again.
errors.change_failed: Couldn't change the password. Try again.

web_port.card_description: The ports this interface listens on. LuCI moves with it.
web_port.http_consequence: The plain-text port for this interface and LuCI.
web_port.https_consequence: The encrypted port for this interface and LuCI.
web_port.invalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 65535.
web_port.same: HTTP and HTTPS need different ports.
web_port.confirm_description: QManager restarts on the new port and this page moves to {{origin}}. If the new port can't start, the old one comes back on its own.
web_port.toast_unreachable: The new port didn't answer, so QManager stayed on the old one.
web_port.error_description: The ports didn't load. Try again in a moment.
